messages:
Aria N: Tessera engineering asked for a compact perf/W + kernel flags sweep for marketplace collateral. They want 3 power caps (55/75/95W), two quant modes (q8, q4_0), and a reproducible kernel cmdline + bios appendix.

Ben C: i'll own the run harness and CSV format. propose fields: run_id,node,batch,seq,quant,power_cap,avg_watt,throughput,p50,p95,kv_hit,kernel_flags. we'll also emit ndjson traces for per-step timings.

Samir D: ops: pin BIOS v2026-04-15 and microcode. vendors asked we mirror their prod kernel for 2 control nodes. we'll run 6 test nodes, rotate kernel-sets and DVFS. capture inlet temps.

Priya V: i'll draft the partner one-pager. Tessera wants a single headline metric (delta_Throughput@75W) but insists on full curves and reproducibility appendix. legal will gate any marketplace claim.

Ben C: draft harness: 
```bash
./partner-bench --model ember-9b --batches 1,2,4 --seq 768 --quant q8,q4_0 \
  --power-cap 55,75,95 --dvfs auto,performance,powersave \
  --kernel-sets stock,latency_tuned,memprefetch \
  --telemetry nvml,rapl,pmu --telemetry-interval 200 \
  --out s3://redwood-partner-bench/tessera/<run>/ --trace ndjson
```

Aria N: add KV-cache hit ratio and per-token timings to the traces. Tessera also asked for plots with watts on x-axis and throughput + p95 overlayed.

bench-bot: scheduled tessera-20260615-01 across 6 nodes starting 2026-06-15T08:00:00Z. live logs at https://bench.redwood.internal/tessera-20260615-01

Samir D: provisioning done. control nodes running vendor-5.18.6. BIOS/microcode pinned. marking node-3 as hot-swap if thermal issues appear.

bench-bot: job tessera-20260615-01/2 finished: batch=2 quant=q4_0 power_cap=75 avg_watt=74.6 throughput=13.2 p50=21.5 p95=48.0 kv_hit=0.90. artifacts -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/tessera/tessera-20260615-01/results/part-0002.jsonl

Ben C: preliminary: latency_tuned kernel shows +6% throughput at 75W and p95 down ~11% vs stock. i'll run bootstrap CI across nodes and post delta_Throughput@75W (95% CI).

Priya V: good. i'll start the one-pager draft but won't publish any claim until stats and legal sign-off. include a reproducibility appendix with exact kernel cmdline + md5.

Samir D: note: node-5 reported elevated inlet temp; excluding it from aggregate and scheduling a retest on spare.

bench-bot: job tessera-20260615-01/5 failed (node-5): thermal throttle events. dmesg -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/tessera/tessera-20260615-01/node-5-dmesg.log

Ben C: reran the config on spare node-8. updated aggregates soon.

bench-bot: updated artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-partner-bench/tessera/tessera-20260615-01/final.zip

Ben C: final aggregates: delta_Throughput@75W = +6.1% (95% CI: 3.2% - 9.0%). p95 improved -10.8% (95% CI: -14.2% to -7.4%).

Priya V: thanks. Action items: Ben (final CSV, plots, and schema), Samir (retest logs and thermal note), Aria (partner sync + one-pager). scheduling partner review Fri 16:00 UTC.

Samir D: ack.

bench-bot: calendar invite sent to Tessera contact and internal reviewers for 2026-06-18T16:00:00Z.
